item.title: Ask HN: Developers–How Did You Get Your First Paying Customers?
item.summary: I Built Pixoate an All in Productivity Design SAAS powered by AI. The Product is very Good, it has Photo Editor, Remove BG, PDF Tools and many more such tools, people are liking it. But I am not on any social Media, neither I like Social Media, How do I promote it, I am Totaly stuck now, I spent 1.5 years building it. Now I came to know that distribution is the main thing , and i am really bad at it as introvert, dont know how to market it. Any Idea how I can distribute it, It is bootstrapped so no marketing budget as well, kind of stuck to be honest , no idea on how to scale it. Can you share your stories how you scaled you SAAS to first 100 customers. Also Please Share your Reviews as Well for Pixoate.com - Are we missing something in terms of Scalability or monetisation Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49187337 Points: 3 # Comments: 2
